title: Structured instruction list with code references
description: Compose sequential procedural steps or technical setup instructions using Card, Heading, List, and Code. The Card frames the container; List manages ordered numbering and item spacing; Code highlights inline commands and keywords.
useWhen: Presenting step-by-step installation guides, developer workflows, recipes, or onboarding checklists containing inline code references.
rules: Set type='ordered' on List when step sequence or chronological order is required; use type='unordered' for non-sequential items.
Use List.Item children to structure each bullet or numbered step cleanly.
Embed inline Code components inside List.Item or Text; inline code dynamically scales with the parent's font size.
Frame lists inside a recessed Card surface='200' surfaceDirection='depth' when visual grouping is needed.
